featured_reviews.name: Drono Acharya
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with Sanjary Automobile was genuinely excellent. I purchased an i20 Asta ABS module from them, and the entire process was smooth and transparent from start to finish.

They shared clear photos of the exact part on WhatsApp, quoted a very reasonable price, and arranged quick delivery via Porter. What really stood out was their professionalism — they didn’t just sell and disappear. They actually followed up to check whether the part was fitted properly in my car.

On top of that, they offered a 3-day verbal warranty, which is extremely rare in this market and shows their confidence and honesty.

They have a vast collection of parts, deep technical knowledge, and a very customer-friendly approach. If you’re looking for reliable used or spare car parts with peace of mind, Sanjary Automobile is a name you can trust.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bought a used brake booster, a new clutch plate set, and a few suspension parts from him, all arranged over the phone. The entire process was smooth and hassle-free. He even coordinated directly with my mechanic whenever needed, which made things a lot easier on my end.

The brake booster initially sent turned out to be faulty, but he replaced it immediately without any questions or back-and-forth. He also accepted returns for a few parts that were ordered but not used, which is rare in this line of work.

Overall, very genuine, responsive, and reasonably priced. Definitely someone you can trust for your car's spare parts.
